failure_modes.text: Healer commitments can reach low health, meet protection or healing, and fail to recreate that deficit before friendly survival ends. Control/resource progress does not measure remaining friendly capacity to finish. A Paladin kill can also be followed by a lost Warrior cleanup.
failure_modes.evidence_scope: Reviewed episodes, illustrative support; no estimated causal effect or complete opportunity frequency.
